title: Approved UTF-8 file mutation
objective: Add exact-target UTF-8 file create/overwrite with local approval, content/current-state binding, stale-target rejection, and post-approval revalidation.

include: MCP tools for preview and approved write

authority_delta.filesystem: Adds approved create/overwrite only inside trusted workspace roots
authority_delta.ui_input: Local Cotra approval prompt only; no agent input authority
authority_delta.approval: Adds independent local soft approval for file writes

invariants: Every write requires local approval on Windows
Existing file writes require exact current SHA-256 from preview
Target state is revalidated after approval before bytes are written
Symlink/junction resolution cannot widen workspace authority
Create parent is re-resolved around creation
Write content is bounded to 2 MiB

acceptance.claim: Preview returns current/new hashes without mutation.
Stale existing content fails with TARGET_STALE and remains unchanged.
Approved existing-file overwrite writes exact content through a verified handle.
Approved create is limited to an authorized resolved parent and detects parent drift.
Denied or unavailable approval never mutates the target.
MCP cannot approve its own request.
Windows and portable CI pass on the exact head.

done_when: Exact-head CI and security review prove approved writes on the bounded surface, the PR is merged, and post-merge CI is green.
